nodes.title: Owner: the 2D teacher puppet must reach at least 4.5/5 on the strict judge before integration; no round limit (polish loop raised to 30 rounds, method changes allowed). Supersedes the 4/5 ship bar in the 2D workflow. Reverse only on the owner's word.

TypeSafe Jev (decision-only model: typed choice + calibrated probability, 70-500 ms, $0.042/1M input, output free; early access) is a candidate for comprehension classification, grading, distress second opinion and choosing among allowed Brain moves. Blocked on: an API key from the owner and explicit owner approval because it is a third-party, non-Azure service receiving child text. Bench against grok/luna on the existing harnesses before any use.
